how_scored: experiments/run_us.py:load_descriptor_arms -> two-stage Ridge plug-in: z-score on the calibration-type fold, Ridge(alpha = 100 if d > 10 else 10) fit b_hat ~ x, predict the evaluation types; pooled over 16 draws (640 route evaluations); AUROC / scene-MAE / Spearman rho.
producer: ORIGINAL PRODUCER MISSING from every repo; reconstructed at experiments/us_official/cmdkin.py:cmdkin and verified bit-for-bit (all 220 x 25 float32 values equal) against the shipped npz, recomputed from the raw anno
producer_status: reconstructed 2026-09; the two surviving slices (eval_cmdkin_kinonly.npz = cols 0:12, eval_cmdkin_cmdonly.npz = cols 12:25) are cut from this file by b2d_irt/scripts/cmdkin_decompose.py

reconstruction.numeric_detail: all statistics are evaluated on the float32 ego/cmd arrays produced by the eval_pipeline.load_anno cast; heading differences are wrapped with the float32 modulo form ((dh + pi) %% (2 pi) - pi). Any other wrap (np.angle(exp(i dh)), np.unwrap, arctan2, or the same modulo in float64) reproduces yaw_mean / yaw_max only to about 1.8e-07, i.e. not bit-for-bit; computing the whole block in float64 breaks 9 of the 25 columns at the float32 ULP level.
reconstruction.scored: AUROC 0.7519106345648979 / scene-MAE 0.18029126621966515 / rho 0.49723177046454564 -- identical to 16 digits to the shipped "Kinematics (cmdkin)" row (experiments/us_official/score_one.py).

verified: all 220 x 25 float32 values regenerated from the raw anno by experiments/us_official/cmdkin.py are bit-for-bit identical to the shipped npz, and the rebuilt file scores identically to 16 digits in Table 3A.

columns.name: v_mean
columns.formula: mean(v)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: v_std
columns.formula: std(v), ddof = 0
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: v_max
columns.formula: max(v)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: v_p10
columns.formula: percentile(v, 10), numpy linear interpolation
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: frac_stop
columns.formula: mean(v < 0.5)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: a_std
columns.formula: std(a), a = diff(v) / 0.1
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: a_min
columns.formula: min(a)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: a_max
columns.formula: max(a)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: a_p05
columns.formula: percentile(a, 5)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: absa_p95
columns.formula: percentile(|a|, 95)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: yaw_mean
columns.formula: mean(|wrap(diff(theta - pi/2))|), radians PER FRAME (not divided by dt)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)

columns.name: yaw_max
columns.formula: max(|wrap(diff(theta - pi/2))|)
columns.input: anno['x'], anno['y'], anno['theta'], anno['speed'] (10 Hz; PDM-Lite reference rollout)
